adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the new pagination params are taken directly from request params (`limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i`, `offset = params[:offset].to_i`) and passed to ActiveRecord (`.limit(limit).offset(offset)`) with no non-negative validation/clamping. A negative `offset` (e.g. `-1`) will be sent to Postgres as `OFFSET -1`, which Postgres rejects, producing a 500 on an anonymous-reachable endpoint. This exposure is widened by the diff because pagination now applies to all groups, not just `automatic?` groups.
